en.title: Gears of the Stars: The Ice Fortress and the Vanished Colony
en.premise: Two major powers, the Empire and the Union, clash over a 'Space Teleportation Device' left behind by an advanced civilization. The story begins when an Imperial reconnaissance ship intercepts a mysterious survival signal from a settlement that was thought to have vanished a century ago. Hidden within an ancient ruin known as the 'Ice Castle' on a freezing planet lies an ultimate weapon capable of redrawing the map of the galaxy. Amidst political intrigue and desperate battlefields where thousands of fleets collide, soldiers must fight for their convictions and their very survival.

zh.title: 星辰之齿轮：冰之要塞与消失的殖民地
zh.premise: 围绕着高度文明留下的“空间传送装置”，帝国与联合两大势力展开激烈冲突。故事始于帝国的侦察舰接收到了一段神秘的生存信号，而该信号来自一个本应在100年前就突然消失的殖民村。在耸立于极寒星球上的被称为“冰之城”的古代遗迹中，沉睡着足以改写银河势力版图的终极武器。在政治阴谋与数千艘舰队交锋的绝望战场上，士兵们正赌上自己的信念与生存进行战斗。
